audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Joshua / Yehoshua first Joshua farewell address, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for Joshua's old age, rest from enemies, remaining nations, Torah adherence, non-assimilation warning, love of YHWH, intermarriage prohibition, good-word fulfillment, and covenant-loss threat.

verses.restored: It was many days after YHWH had given rest to Israel from all their enemies around, and Joshua was old, advanced in days,

familiar.text: And it came to pass a long time after that the LORD had given rest unto Israel from all their enemies round about, that Joshua waxed old and stricken in age.

modern.text: A long time after the LORD had given Israel rest from all the enemies around them, when Joshua was old and well along in years,

original.text: וַֽיְהִי֙ מִיָּמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים אַ֠חֲרֵי אֲשֶׁר הֵנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֧ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מִכָּל אֹיְבֵיהֶ֖ם מִסָּבִ֑יב וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִֽים

verses.restored: that Joshua called to all Israel, to its elders, heads, judges, and officers, and said to them, I am old, advanced in days.

familiar.text: And Joshua called for all Israel, and for their elders, and for their heads, and for their judges, and for their officers, and said unto them, I am old and stricken in age:

modern.text: he summoned all Israel, including its elders, leaders, judges, and officers. “I am old and well along in years,” he said,

original.text: וַיִּקְרָ֤א יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ לְכָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִזְקֵנָיו֙ וּלְרָאשָׁ֔יו וּלְשֹׁפְטָ֖יו וּלְשֹֽׁטְרָ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם אֲנִ֣י זָקַ֔נְתִּי בָּ֖אתִי בַּיָּמִֽים

verses.restored: You have seen all YHWH your Divine did to all these nations before you, for YHWH your Divine is the one who fought for you.

familiar.text: And ye have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto all these nations because of you; for the LORD your God is he that hath fought for you.

modern.text: “and you have seen everything that the LORD your God has done to all these nations for your sake, because it was the LORD your God who fought for you.

original.text: וְאַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֗ם אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם לְכָל הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִפְּנֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֖וּא הַנִּלְחָ֥ם לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: See, I have caused to fall to you these remaining nations as inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, and all nations I cut off, as far as Great Sea toward going down of sun.

familiar.text: Behold, I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even unto the great sea westward.

modern.text: See, I have allotted as an inheritance to your tribes these remaining nations, including all the nations I have already cut off, from the Jordan westward to the Great Sea.

original.text: רְאוּ֩ הִפַּ֨לְתִּי לָכֶ֜ם אֶֽת הַ֠גּוֹיִם הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֛לֶּה בְּנַחֲלָ֖ה לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶ֑ם מִן הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן וְכָל הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכְרַ֔תִּי וְהַיָּ֥ם הַגָּד֖וֹל מְב֥וֹא הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ

verses.restored: YHWH your Divine, he will thrust them out from before you and dispossess them from before you, and you shall possess their land, as YHWH your Divine spoke to you.

familiar.text: And the LORD your God, he shall expel them from before you, and drive them from out of your sight; and ye shall possess their land, as the LORD your God hath promised unto you.

modern.text: The LORD your God will push them out of your way and drive them out before you, so that you can take possession of their land, as the LORD your God promised you.

original.text: וַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֗ם ה֚וּא יֶהְדֳּפֵ֣ם מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם וְהוֹרִ֥ישׁ אֹתָ֖ם מִלִּפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וִֽירִשְׁתֶּם֙ אֶת אַרְצָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: Be very strong to keep and do all written in scroll of Torah of Moses, not turning from it right or left,

familiar.text: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left;

modern.text: Be very strong, then, so that you can keep and obey all that is written in the Book of the Law of Moses, not turning aside from it to the right or to the left.

original.text: וַחֲזַקְתֶּ֣ם מְאֹ֔ד לִשְׁמֹ֣ר וְלַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֵ֚ת כָּל הַכָּת֔וּב בְּסֵ֖פֶר תּוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֑ה לְבִלְתִּ֥י סוּר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ יָמִ֥ין וּשְׂמֹֽאול

verses.restored: so you do not enter among these nations, these remaining with you. Name of their gods you shall not mention, and by them you shall not swear, serve them, or bow to them.

familiar.text: That ye come not among these nations, these that remain among you; neither make mention of the name of their gods, nor cause to swear by them, neither serve them, nor bow yourselves unto them:

modern.text: So you are not to associate with these nations that remain among you. You must not call on the names of their gods or swear by them, and you must not serve them or bow down to them.

original.text: לְבִלְתִּי בוֹא֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אִתְּכֶ֑ם וּבְשֵׁ֨ם אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֤ם לֹא תַזְכִּ֨ירוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א תַשְׁבִּ֔יעוּ וְלֹ֣א תַעַבְד֔וּם וְלֹ֥א תִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָהֶֽם

verses.restored: But to YHWH your Divine you shall cling, as you have done to this day.

familiar.text: But cleave unto the LORD your God, as ye have done unto this day.

modern.text: Instead, you shall hold fast to the LORD your God, as you have done to this day.

original.text: כִּ֛י אִם בַּיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם תִּדְבָּ֑קוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: YHWH dispossessed from before you nations great and mighty; as for you, no man has stood before you to this day.

familiar.text: For the LORD hath driven out from before you great nations and strong: but as for you, no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day.

modern.text: The LORD has driven out great and powerful nations before you, and to this day no one can stand against you.

original.text: וַיּ֤וֹרֶשׁ יְהוָה֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם גּוֹיִ֖ם גְּדֹלִ֣ים וַעֲצוּמִ֑ים וְאַתֶּ֗ם לֹא עָ֤מַד אִישׁ֙ בִּפְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: One man from you pursues a thousand, because YHWH your Divine is the one fighting for you, as he spoke to you.

familiar.text: One man of you shall chase a thousand: for the LORD your God, he it is that fighteth for you, as he hath promised you.

modern.text: One of you can put a thousand to flight, because the LORD your God fights for you, just as He promised.

original.text: אִישׁ אֶחָ֥ד מִכֶּ֖ם יִרְדָּף אָ֑לֶף כִּ֣י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֗ם ה֚וּא הַנִּלְחָ֣ם לָכֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָכֶֽם

verses.restored: Guard yourselves greatly for your souls/lives, to love YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves, that ye love the LORD your God.

modern.text: Therefore watch yourselves carefully, that you love the LORD your God.

original.text: וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם מְאֹ֖ד לְנַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶ֑ם לְאַהֲבָ֖ה אֶת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: For if you turn back and cling to remnant of these nations, these remaining with you, and make marriages with them, and go in to them and they to you,

familiar.text: Else if ye do in any wise go back, and cleave unto the remnant of these nations, even these that remain among you, and shall make marriages with them, and go in unto them, and they to you:

modern.text: For if you turn away and cling to the rest of these nations that remain among you, and if you intermarry and associate with them,

original.text: כִּ֣י אִם שׁ֣וֹב תָּשׁ֗וּבוּ וּדְבַקְתֶּם֙ בְּיֶ֨תֶר֙ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה אִתְּכֶ֑ם וְהִֽתְחַתַּנְתֶּ֥ם בָּהֶ֛ם וּבָאתֶ֥ם בָּהֶ֖ם וְהֵ֥ם בָּכֶֽם

verses.restored: know surely that YHWH your Divine will not continue to dispossess these nations from before you; they shall become for you snare, trap, whip in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from upon this good ground YHWH your Divine gave you.

familiar.text: Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

modern.text: know for sure that the LORD your God will no longer drive out these nations before you. Instead, they will become for you a snare and a trap, a scourge in your sides and thorns in your eyes, until you perish from this good land that the LORD your God has given you.

original.text: יָד֨וֹעַ֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יוֹסִ֜יף יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֗ם לְהוֹרִ֛ישׁ אֶת הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִלִּפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָי֨וּ לָכֶ֜ם לְפַ֣ח וּלְמוֹקֵ֗שׁ וּלְשֹׁטֵ֤ט בְּצִדֵּיכֶם֙ וְלִצְנִנִ֣ים בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֔ם עַד אֲבָדְכֶ֗ם מֵ֠עַל הָאֲדָמָ֤ה הַטּוֹבָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: Look, I am going today in way of all earth. You know with all your heart and all your soul/life that not one word has fallen from all good words YHWH your Divine spoke concerning you; all came for you; not one word fell from it.

familiar.text: And, behold, this day I am going the way of all the earth: and ye know in all your hearts and in all your souls, that not one thing hath failed of all the good things which the LORD your God spake concerning you; all are come to pass unto you, and not one thing hath failed thereof.

modern.text: Now behold, today I am going the way of all the earth, and you know with all your heart and soul that not one of the good promises the LORD your God made to you has failed. Everything was fulfilled for you; not one promise has failed.

original.text: וְהִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֤י הוֹלֵךְ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם בְּדֶ֖רֶךְ כָּל הָאָ֑רֶץ וִידַעְתֶּ֞ם בְּכָל לְבַבְכֶ֣ם וּבְכָל נַפְשְׁכֶ֗ם כִּ֣י לֹֽא נָפַל֩ דָּבָ֨ר אֶחָ֜ד מִכֹּ֣ל הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הַטּוֹבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֜ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם הַכֹּל֙ בָּ֣אוּ לָכֶ֔ם לֹֽא נָפַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖נּוּ דָּבָ֥ר אֶחָֽד

verses.restored: It shall be, as every good word came upon you that YHWH your Divine spoke to you, so YHWH will bring upon you every evil word until he destroys you from upon this good ground YHWH your Divine gave you,

familiar.text: Therefore it shall come to pass, that as all good things are come upon you, which the LORD your God promised you; so shall the LORD bring upon you all evil things, until he have destroyed you from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

modern.text: But just as every good thing the LORD your God promised you has come to pass, likewise the LORD will bring upon you the calamity He has threatened, until He has destroyed you from this good land He has given you.

original.text: וְהָיָ֗ה כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּ֤א עֲלֵיכֶם֙ כָּל הַדָּבָ֣ר הַטּ֔וֹב אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם כֵּן֩ יָבִ֨יא יְהוָ֜ה עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת כָּל הַדָּבָ֣ר הָרָ֔ע עַד הַשְׁמִיד֣וֹ אוֹתְכֶ֗ם מֵ֠עַל הָאֲדָמָ֤ה הַטּוֹבָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם

verses.restored: when you cross covenant of YHWH your Divine that he commanded you and go and serve other gods and bow to them; anger of YHWH will burn against you, and you shall perish quickly from upon good land he gave you.

familiar.text: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the LORD your God, which he commanded you, and have gone and served other gods, and bowed yourselves to them; then shall the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you.

modern.text: If you transgress the covenant of the LORD your God, which He commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them, then the anger of the LORD will burn against you, and you will quickly perish from this good land He has given you.”

original.text: בְּ֠עָבְרְכֶם אֶת בְּרִ֨ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה אֶתְכֶם֒ וַהֲלַכְתֶּ֗ם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָהֶ֑ם וְחָרָ֤ה אַף יְהוָה֙ בָּכֶ֔ם וַאֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם מְהֵרָ֔ה מֵעַל֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר נָתַ֥ן לָכֶֽם

translation_notes: Joshua again speaks as an aging leader whose authority is used to warn and transfer responsibility, not to pretend immortality.
The address openly acknowledges remaining nations living with Israel, complicating earlier total-conquest summaries.
The warning against naming, serving, and swearing by other gods belongs to Israel's covenant boundary and must not authorize persecution of other religions or suppression of speech today.
The intermarriage warning is ancient religious-boundary rhetoric, not a modern ethnic-purity rule or permission for racism, xenophobia, or control of intimate relationships.
Images of snare, trap, whip, and thorns are covenant-danger metaphors and must not be used to dehumanize neighboring peoples or mixed families.
Fulfillment language in verse 14 is immediately paired with warning in verses 15-16; it is theological rhetoric, not simple historical accounting.
Love of YHWH is framed as guarded covenant allegiance, but love cannot be coerced through domination or fear.
safety_note: Do not use Joshua 23 to promote ethnic purity, anti-intermarriage ideology, religious persecution, racism, or contempt for neighboring peoples. Center aging leadership that releases responsibility, disciplined love, covenant memory, and honest recognition that communities remain mixed and ethically accountable.
